business_contract: Use the accepted C07 DRAOS=N two-aircraft, two-hour crew-dependent preparation model. Change only ShiftProfile windows to elapsed hours 23-24 and 25-27, active ShiftResource.QTY to two equal to nominal capacity, planned mission start to hour 28, and the description. The mission request remains four and a half hours before the planned start, at hour 23.5. The 24-25 interval is a positive gap between explicit shifts; DRAOS=N makes crew unavailable then.
expected_native_hypothesis: Both aircraft should work in parallel from 23.5-24, stop with 1.5 hours remaining, wait through 24-25, resume at 25, finish at 26.5 and fly the 28-29 formation. Native behavior, timing and ledgers remain hypotheses until a guarded run and independent replay.
acceptance_requires: valid nonempty native event log and report
per-aircraft stop, resume, completion and mission events
resource use and wait bins and totals
terminal system and stock ledger checks
limitations: This models an elapsed 24-hour boundary, not a named calendar day or verified weekend rule.
Two explicit non-repeating shifts, one station, one resource, one seed and DRAOS=N only.
Repeating or nested shifts, true weekend profile, DRAOS=Y, MAXUT, GUI behavior and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
